content.comment_body: Hello everyone! What methods do you use to access [product_name] from outside your local network? I want to view data from [product_name], which is transferred via Modbus TCP and can be displayed on the [product_name] web server. Thank you in advance for any assistance.
If [product_name] and the other device are on different IP subnets, you'll need a gateway to connect them.
Have you seen this FAQ from [company_name]? It covers communication between [product_name] via Modbus TCP IP.
Thank you. I've already read that manual and the communication between [product_name] and POC1000 is working fine. My question is how can you view the monitored values while away from home?
You should try using a VPN...

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing remote access to data on [product_name], with data transferred over Modbus TCP and displayed through the web server functionality. There's interest in simple methods for remote monitoring, especially when devices are on separate networks. Suggestions include using VPNs, and users highlight challenges related to network setup and secure remote access.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a secure, easy-to-configure way to remotely monitor [product_name] data, ideally without requiring advanced networking knowledge or complex setup.
